items.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
items.takeaway: slime team's frontier TR: SFT->Reasoning RL->Agentic RL->General RL->On-Policy Cross-Stage Distillation; 10k+ SWE envs via RepoLaunch; Harbor terminal envs; binary test rewards + noise filtering (pad-or-drop group rule); TITO Gateway token-faithful trajectories; GRPO+IcePop eps 0.2/0.28; error segments kept but loss-masked in SFT; async RL w/ weight push every K updates + optimizer reset

items.name: deepseek_v4_tr
items.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token (report)
items.takeaway: FRONTIER VALIDATION OF OUR OPD DESIGN: 'the mixed RL stage was entirely replaced by On-Policy Distillation' - domain specialists via SFT+GRPO w/ domain-tailored reward models (incl. Generative Reward Model), then unified model consolidates via OPD (reverse-KL); Efficient Teacher Scheduling for Full-Vocabulary OPD (ZeRO-like teacher sharding, cache last-layer hidden states not logits); DSec sandbox: globally-ordered trajectory log, preemption-safe resumption via cached replay; seq curriculum 4K->16K->64K->1M
